framings.text: I think this is about helping the next person understand what was actually checked before dogfooding, while keeping early thinking private and preventing questions judged unuseful from recurring.

outcome: Before dogfooding, the next person can quickly distinguish real-model evidence, stub mechanics, and the operator's own recognition, while early scratch thinking stays separate and unuseful questions do not recur.

questions.text: Should scratch thinking remain entirely separate unless someone explicitly chooses to carry it into the PR?

alternatives.label: Conditional candidate: add a compact PR-thread receipt after relevant checks
alternatives.benefit: Makes the three kinds of evidence visible with little manual effort, if the details are available.
alternatives.cost: A compact receipt may omit context or become stale after changes.
alternatives.undo_cost: Provisional: correcting or removing it may require follow-up clarification.

alternatives.label: Conditional candidate: reuse existing evidence links in a lightweight PR-thread summary
alternatives.benefit: Avoids a new receipt format and reduces repetitive entry.
alternatives.cost: Evidence may remain fragmented or depend on links being kept current.
alternatives.undo_cost: Provisional: returning to scattered evidence may make context harder to recover.
